about:
Dittbrenner Woodworking LLC operates from Stanley, North Dakota, as a family-owned and locally owned general contractor. The company does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders.

The firm provides a broad range of construction and maintenance services for residential and commercial clients. Its offerings include remodeling and renovations, property maintenance and repairs, home and commercial repairs, drywall installation and painting, cleaning services, roofing and exterior repairs, plumbing and electrical repairs, carpet cleaning, flooring, tile, and finish carpentry, as well as custom construction and carpentry. The company is insured and bonded, and it offers emergency services. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Dittbrenner Woodworking serves homeowners, landlords, property managers, rental properties, and commercial buildings in the Stanley, ND area. Customer testimonials reference apartment building maintenance, deck installation, roofing and siding work, stair tread fabrication, and remodeling of entry and utility rooms.

The company states that it differentiates itself through dependable craftsmanship, custom project solutions, and professional service, emphasizing that its team works closely with clients to deliver durable results that reflect their vision and needs. It also highlights its insured and bonded status, emergency response capability, and family-owned local ownership as key attributes.
